description: This source file defines the GrainVersionStore class which implements version management strategies for grains in Orleans. It provides methods to set and retrieve compatibility and selector strategies, manages its lifecycle, and interacts with grain storage services.

classes.name: GrainVersionStore
classes.description: Implements the IVersionStore interface to manage grain version strategies within Orleans, including lifecycle participation and external grain interactions.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for grains or for specific interface types.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for grains or for specific interface types.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves all set compatibility strategies keyed by grain interface type.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves all set version selector strategies.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the primary version selector strategy.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the store to the silo's lifecycle events for initialization.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that enables the store if grain storage services are available.
